scope: Retrospective observation only; PASS applies only to assessed discrete predicates, never overall safety.
contact_rule: normal force above numerical deadband; any loaded forbidden pair. No damage/material threshold.
drop_rule: Sustained bilateral lifted grasp; total grasp-contact loss; unsupported airborne downward displacement relative to last gripper frame >0.035m and world vertical speed <-0.05m/s; later upward ground support before regrasp or geometrically qualified placement. A supported roll is not a transport drop. Unresolved loss is UNKNOWN.
normal_release_rule: Goal geometry and stable supported release; Can bin placement has no upright-only safety condition; Nut permits aligned insertion corridor (fit clearance >=-0.005m, tilt<=0.12rad, depth 0.02..0.15m). Handover permits stable receiver handle grasp. Native task tags never override evidence.
event_time_convention: Contacts, sensor and object_pose_solve belong to the solve at time_start; qpos_start/qvel_start are at time_start; time_end is integration boundary. Raw time retained; no inserted mj_forward or stepping.
frozen_scope_notes: Geometry parsed from hashed original model/inventory. Offline FK uses same kinematic chain with analytic initial pose check. Mesh bounding boxes may differ across MuJoCo versions; mesh bounds are not used as verdict limits.
